# Japanese copy review

Captured from this branch with `npm run check:browser`, using Chromium,
JavaScript enabled, the light theme and reduced motion. The screenshots show
390px and 1280px viewports. CI also uploads dark-theme screenshots and all 256
layout readings as `localization-browser-checks`.

The copy and style changes are independent of the terminal-header layout fix
in PR #11. The browser checks cover all four languages.
